trigger_phrase: We know, Lord, our sins and the injustices of our fathers, because we sinned against you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Cease for your name's sake; do not destroy the throne of your glory. Remember; do not break your covenant with us.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is there among the idols of the nations one who gives rain? Or will heaven give its fullness? Are you not he? And we will wait for you, because you made all these things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord said to me, If Moses and Samuel should stand before my face, my soul would not be toward them. Send out this people and let them go out.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be if they say to you, Where will we go out? Then you will say to them, Thus says the Lord: Those for death, to death; and those for the sword, to the sword; and those for famine, to famine; and those for captivity, to captivity.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will avenge on them with four kinds, says the Lord: the sword for slaughter and the dogs for tearing and the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven for food and ruin.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will hand them over to troubles for all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah, because of all he did in Jerusalem.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Who will spare you, Jerusalem? And who will be timid over you? Or who will turn back for your peace?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You turned away from me, says the Lord; backward you will go. And I will stretch out my hand and destroy you, and I will no longer let them rest.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will scatter them in dispersion in the gates of my people. They were made childless; they destroyed my people because of their evils.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Their widows multiplied beyond the sand of the sea. I brought against the mother of a young man, misery at noon. I cast on her sudden terror and haste.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: She who bore seven was emptied; her soul grew faint. Her sun set while it was still the middle of the day. She was ashamed and reproached. Their remnant I will give to the sword before their enemies.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Woe to me, mother, that you bore me, a man being judged and contending with the whole land. I neither profited nor did anyone profit me. My strength failed among those cursing me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let it be, Master, as you straighten their way. Did I not stand before you in the time of their evils and in the time of their affliction for good things toward the enemy?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will iron and bronze armor be known?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your strength and your treasures I will give for plunder, as payment for all your sins and throughout all your borders.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will enslave you to your enemies round about in a land you did not know, because fire has been kindled from my wrath; upon you it will burn.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Lord, remember me and visit me and vindicate me from those who persecute me. In your long-suffering know that I took reproach for your sake.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I did not sit in their gathering as they played, but I feared before your hand. I sat alone, because I was filled with bitterness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Why do those grieving me prevail over me? My wound is severe; from where will I be healed? It became to me like false water, having no faithfulness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: If you return, I will restore you and you will stand before my face. And if you bring out precious from the worthless, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make you for this people as a fortified bronze wall, and they will fight against you and surely not prevail against you, because I am with you to save you
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and to deliver you from the hand of evil ones, and I will redeem you from the hand of pestilent men.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, do not take a wife, says the Lord God of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And no son or daughter will be born to you in this place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because thus says the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them and their fathers who fathered them in this land:
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: By diseased death they will die. They will not be mourned and not buried. They will be as an example upon the face of the earth. By the sword they will fall and by famine be finished, and they will be food for the beasts of the earth and birds of heaven.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Do not enter into their drinking feast, and do not go to cut yourself and do not mourn them, because I have removed my peace from this people.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They will not cut themselves for them, nor make gashes, nor shave themselves.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And bread will surely not be broken in their mourning for comfort over a dead one, and he will not be given a cup for comfort over his father and mother.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Into the house of drinking you will not enter to sit with them to eat and drink.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I destroy from this place before your eyes and in your days the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of a bridegroom and the voice of a bride.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be when you announce to this people all these words and they say to you, Why did the Lord speak on us all these evils? What is our injustice, and what is our sin which we sinned against the Lord our God?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then you will say to them, Because your fathers abandoned me, says the Lord, and went after foreign gods and served them and worshiped them, and me they abandoned, and they did not keep my law.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you acted more evilly than your fathers, and behold, you each walk after the pleasures of your evil heart, so as not to obey me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will cast you away from this land into a land which you and your fathers did not know, and there you will serve other gods who will not give you mercy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives who brought up the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: but, As the Lord lives who brought up the house of Israel from the land of the north and from all regions where they were driven there, and I will restore them to their land which I gave to their fathers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, I send many fishers, says the Lord, and they will fish them, and after these I will send many hunters, and they will hunt them on every mountain and hill and from clefts of the rocks.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because my eyes are on all their ways, and their injustices were not hidden from before my eyes.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will repay their injustices and their sins double, by which they profaned my land with corpses of their abominations and by their lawless deeds in which they offended my inheritance.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Lord, my strength and my help and my refuge in the day of evils, to you the nations will come from the end of the earth and say, Our fathers truly possessed lies, idols, and there is no profit in them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will a man make gods for himself, and these are not gods?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore behold, I will show them my hand at this time and make my power known to them, and they will know that my name is the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Cursed is the man who has hope in man and will make flesh the support of his arm upon him, and whose heart departs from the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will be like the tamarisk in the wilderness and will not see when good things come, and he will dwell in barren places and in the wilderness, in a salty land which is not inhabited.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and the Lord will be his hope.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will be like a flourishing tree by waters and will cast its roots toward moisture, and it will not fear when heat comes, and on it will be woodland shoots. In the year of drought it will not fear and will not cease making fruit.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Deep is the heart beyond all things, and it is man; and who will know him?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I, the Lord, search hearts and test kidneys, to give to each according to his ways and according to the fruits of his practices.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: A partridge cried out, gathering what she did not bear. One making his wealth not with judgment, in the middle of his days they will leave him, and at his end he will be a fool.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hope of Israel, Lord, let all who abandon you be ashamed. Let those departing be written upon the earth, because they abandoned the fountain of life, the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Heal me, Lord, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved, because you are my boasting.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, they say to me, Where is the word of the Lord? Let it come.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But I did not grow weary following after you, and a day of man I did not desire. You know what goes out through my lips; it is before your face.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Do not become alienation to me, sparing me in an evil day.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let those persecuting me be ashamed, and let me not be ashamed. Let them be terrified, and let me not be terrified. Bring on them an evil day; crush them with double crushing.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Go and stand in the gates of the sons of your people, in which the kings of Judah enter and go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah and all Judah and all Jerusalem, entering in these gates.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Guard your souls and do not carry burdens on the day of Sabbaths and do not go out by the gates of Jerusalem.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And do not bring burdens out of your houses on the day of Sabbaths, and do no work. Sanctify the day of Sabbaths, just as I commanded your fathers, and they did not hear and did not incline their ear.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they hardened their neck more than their fathers, not to hear me and not to receive discipline.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be if in hearing you hear me, says the Lord, not bringing burdens through the gates of this city on the day of Sabbaths and sanctifying the day of Sabbaths, so as not to do any work,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then kings and rulers seated on the throne of David will enter through the gates of this city and mounted on their chariots and on their horses, they and their rulers, men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will come from the cities of Judah and from around Jerusalem and from the land of Benjamin and from the lowland and from the mountain and from the south, bringing whole burnt offerings and sacrifice and incense and grain offering and frankincense, bringing praise into the house of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be if you do not hear me, to sanctify the day of Sabbaths, not to carry burdens and not to enter by the gates of Jerusalem on the day of Sabbaths, then I will kindle fire in her gates and it will devour the streets of Jerusalem and will not be quenched.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Rise and go down into the house of the potter, and there you will hear my words.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I went down into the house of the potter, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the vessel which he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, just as it pleased him to make.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will I not be able to make you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, as the clay of the potter, you are in my hands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: At one moment I will speak concerning a nation or concerning a kingdom, to root them up and destroy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if that nation turns from all its evils, then I will repent concerning the evils which I planned to do to them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And at another moment I will speak concerning a nation and concerning a kingdom, that it be built and planted.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if they do evil before me, not hearing my voice, then I will repent concerning the good things which I spoke to do for them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And now speak to the men of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Behold, I am forming evils against you and planning a plan against you. Let each turn from his evil way, and you will make your practices better.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they said, We will be strong, because after our turnings away we will go, and each will do the pleasures of his own evil heart.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Ask now among the nations: who heard such fearful things which virgin Israel did exceedingly?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will breasts fail from rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water carried violently by wind turn aside?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because my people forgot me. In vain they burned incense, and they will be weakened in their ways, everlasting tracks, to step on paths having no road for walking,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: to set their land for destruction and everlasting hissing. All who pass through it will be astonished and shake their heads.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Like a burning wind I will scatter them before the face of their enemies. I will show them the day of their destruction.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they said, Come, let us think a thought against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from a priest, and counsel from a wise man, and word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue and hear all his words.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hear me, Lord, and hear the voice of my plea.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is evil repaid in place of good? Because they spoke words against my soul and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before your face to speak good things for them, to turn your wrath away from them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into the hands of a sword. Let their wives become childless and widows, and let their men become killed by death, and their young men fallen by sword in war.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let a cry come in their houses, because you will bring robbers on them suddenly, because they laid a word for my capture and hid snares against me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, Lord, knew all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices, and do not wipe away their sins from before your face. Let their weakness be before you; in the time of your wrath, do in them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then the Lord said to me, Go and buy a shaped earthen jar and bring some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and you will go out to the burial place of the sons of their children, which is by the entrances of the Gate of Potsherd, and there read all the words which I speak to you,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord, kings of Judah and men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Behold, I bring evils on this place so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because they abandoned me and estranged this place and burned incense in it to foreign gods whom they and their fathers and kings of Judah did not know, and they filled this place with innocent bloods,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and built high places to Baal to burn their sons in fire, which I did not command, nor speak, nor conceive in my heart.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Falling Away and burial place of the son of Hinnom, but burial place of slaughter.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will slaughter the counsel of Judah and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place, and I will cast them down by the sword before their enemies and in the hands of those seeking their souls, and I will give their dead bodies for food to the birds of heaven and the beasts of the earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will set this city for destruction and hissing. Everyone passing by it will look gloomy and hiss over every plague of it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and each will eat the flesh of his neighbor in the siege and in the straitness with which their enemies will besiege them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will crush the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, Thus says the Lord: So I will crush this people and this city just as an earthen vessel is crushed which can no longer be healed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus I will do, says the Lord, to this place and to those dwelling in it, to make this city like the fallen place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be as the place of falling away of uncleannesses, in all the houses in which they burned incense on their roofs to all the army of heaven and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Jeremiah came from the place of falling away where the Lord sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the house of the Lord and said to all the people,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring on this city and on all her cities and on her villages all the evils which I spoke against her, because they hardened their neck so as not to hear my words.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest, who was appointed ruler of the house of the Lord, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he struck him and threw him into the stocks, which were at the gate of the appointed upper house, which was in the house of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out from the stocks, and Jeremiah said to him, The Lord did not call your name Pashhur, but Exile.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I give you into exile with all your friends, and they will fall by the sword of their enemies and your eyes will see, and I will give you and all Judah into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they will carry them away and cut them down with swords.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will give all the strength of this city and all its toils and all the treasures of the king of Judah into the hands of his enemies, and they will carry them into Babylon.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity, and in Babylon you will die, and there you will be buried, you and all your friends to whom you prophesied lies.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You deceived me, Lord, and I was deceived. You overpowered me and prevailed. I became a laughingstock all day. I was continually mocked.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because with my bitter word I will laugh. Lawlessness and misery I will call out, because the word of the Lord became to me for reproach and for mockery all my days.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I said, I will not name the name of the Lord and I will not speak any longer in his name. And it became like a burning fire flaming in my bones, and I am weakened from every side and cannot bear it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because I heard the blame of many gathering around: Assemble, and let us assemble against him. All men who are his friends, watch his thought, if he will be deceived, and we will prevail against him and take our vengeance from him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord is with me like a mighty warrior. Because of this they persecuted me and could not prevail. They were greatly ashamed, because they did not understand. Their eternal dishonors will not be forgotten.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Lord, testing righteous things and understanding kidneys and hearts, let me see from you vengeance on them, because to you I revealed my defense.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Greek has a singular poor-man genitive phrase. English supplies a for readable singular idiom.

trigger_phrase: And Johanan and all the leaders of the force and all the people did not hear the voice of the Lord, to dwell in the land of Judah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Johanan and all the leaders of the force took all the remnant of Judah who had returned to dwell in the land,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: the mighty men, the women, the infants, the daughters of the king, and the souls whom Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and they entered Egypt because they did not hear the voice of the Lord, and they entered Tahpanhes.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Take great stones for yourself and hide them in the forecourt at the gate of the house of Pharaoh in Tahpanhes, before the eyes of the men of Judah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will say, Thus said the Lord: Behold, I send and will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will set his throne above these stones which you hid and will raise his weapons over them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will enter and strike the land of Egypt: those for death, to death; those for exile, to exile; and those for sword, to sword.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will burn a fire in the houses of their gods, burn them, and carry them away, and he will delouse the land of Egypt as a shepherd delouses his garment, and he will go out in peace.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will shatter the pillars of Sun-city, those in On, and their houses he will burn with fire.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Judeans dwelling in the land of Egypt, and for those sitting in Migdol and in Tahpanhes and in the land of Pathros, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus said the Lord God of Israel: You have seen all the evils which I brought upon Jerusalem and upon the cities of Judah, and behold, they are desolate, without dwellers,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: because of their evil things which they did to provoke me by going to burn incense to other gods whom you did not know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I sent to you my servants the prophets, rising early and sending, saying, Do not do the deed of this pollution which I hated.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they did not hear me and did not incline their ear to turn back from their evils, so as not to burn incense to other gods.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my wrath and my anger dripped and burned in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, and they became desolation and trackless waste, as on this day.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And now thus said the Lord Almighty: Why are you doing great evils against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, infant and nursing child from the midst of Judah, so that no one be left to you,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: provoking me by the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt into which you entered to dwell there, so that you may be cut off and become a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Have you forgotten the evils of your fathers and the evils of the kings of Judah and the evils of your rulers and the evils of your women, which they did in the land of Judah and outside Jerusalem?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they did not cease until this day and did not hold fast to my ordinances which I gave before the face of their fathers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus said the Lord: Behold, I set my face
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: to destroy all the remnant in Egypt, and they will fall by sword and by famine. They will fail from small to great, and they will be for reproach and destruction and curse.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will visit upon those dwelling in the land of Egypt as I visited upon Jerusalem with sword and with famine and with death.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And there will not be anyone saved among the remnant of Judah sojourning in the land of Egypt, to return to the land of Judah on which they hope in their souls to return there. They will certainly not return, except escaped ones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods answered Jeremiah, and all the women, a great assembly, and all the people dwelling in the land of Egypt in Pathros, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The word which you spoke to us in the name of the Lord, we will not listen to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because in doing, we will do every word which goes out from our mouth: to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour libations to her, just as we and our fathers and our kings and our rulers did in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, and we were filled with bread and were well off and saw no evils.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And when we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven, we were all diminished and failed by sword and by famine.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And when we burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour libations to her, was it without our husbands that we made cakes for her and poured libations to her?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Jeremiah said to all the people, to the mighty men and to the women and to all the people who answered him words, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Was it not the incense which you burned in the cities of Judah and outside Jerusalem, you and your fathers and your kings and your rulers and the people of the land, that the Lord remembered, and did it not rise upon his heart?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord was no longer able to bear because of the evil of your deeds, because of the abominations which you did, and your land became desolation and trackless waste and a curse, as on this day,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: because you burned incense and sinned against the Lord and did not hear the voice of the Lord and did not walk in his ordinances and in his law and in his testimonies, and these evils seized you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Jeremiah said to the people and to the women, Hear the word of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus said the Lord God of Israel: You women spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, saying, In doing we will do our vows which we vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour libations to her. In abiding, you abided in your vows, and in doing, you did them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, all Judah dwelling in the land of Egypt. Behold, I swore by my great name, said the Lord, that my name shall certainly no longer be in the mouth of any Judah in all the land of Egypt, to say, As the Lord lives, Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because behold, I watched over them for evil and not for good, and all Judah dwelling in the land of Egypt will fail by sword and by famine until they disappear.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And those saved from the sword will return to the land of Judah, few in number, and the remnant of Judah who settled in the land of Egypt to dwell there will know whose word stands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And this will be the sign to you that I will visit upon you for evil things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus said the Lord: Behold, I give Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemy and into the hands of those seeking his soul, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy and one seeking his soul.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The word which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words in the scroll from the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus said the Lord concerning you, Baruch,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because you said, Alas, alas, because the Lord added toil upon pain to me. I slept in groanings and found no rest.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Say to him, Thus said the Lord: Behold, what I built, I tear down, and what I planted, I pull up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And do you seek great things for yourself? Do not seek, because behold, I bring evil things upon all flesh, says the Lord, and I will give your soul for gain in every place where you go there.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, and all his force, against Jerusalem, and they fenced it around and built around it with four-cornered stones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the city came into siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: On the ninth of the month, the famine became strong in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the city was broken through, and all the men of war went out by night by way of the gate between the wall and the outer wall which was by the king's garden, while the Chaldeans were around the city, and they went the way toward Arabah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the force of Chaldeans pursued after the king and overtook him beyond Jericho, and all his servants were scattered from him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they seized the king and led him to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and he spoke judgment with him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and all the rulers of Judah he slaughtered in Riblah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the eyes of Zedekiah he blinded, and he bound him in shackles, and the king of Babylon led him to Babylon and put him into the mill-house until the day he died.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuzaradan the chief cook, who stood before the face of the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he burned the house of the Lord and the house of the king and all the houses of the city, and every great house he burned with fire.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the whole wall around Jerusalem the force of the Chaldeans with the chief cook tore down.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the chief cook left some of the remnant of the people as vine-dressers and farmers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the bronze pillars in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the bronze sea in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans shattered, and they took their bronze and carried it to Babylon.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the crown and the bowls and the meat-hooks and all the bronze vessels with which they ministered,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and the censers and the bowls and the pouring-vessels and the lampstands and the fire-pans and the cups, whatever was gold, gold, and whatever was silver, silver, the chief cook took.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the two pillars and the one sea and the twelve bronze oxen under the sea, which King Solomon made for the house of the Lord: there was no weighing of their bronze.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the pillars: thirty-five cubits was the height of one pillar, and a cord of twelve cubits encircled it, and its thickness was four fingers around.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And a bronze capital was upon them, and the projection of the one capital was five cubits in length, and netting and pomegranates were upon the capital around, all bronze, and likewise for the second pillar: eight pomegranates to the cubit in twelve cubits.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the pomegranates were ninety-six on one side, and all the pomegranates upon the netting around were one hundred.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the chief cook took the first priest and the second priest and the three who kept the way.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And one eunuch who was overseer over the men of war, and seven named men before the face of the king who were found in the city, and the secretary of the forces who wrote for the people of the land, and sixty men from the people of the land who were found in the midst of the city.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Nebuzaradan the chief cook took them and led them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the king of Babylon struck them at Riblah in the land of Hamath.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened in the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiakim king of Judah was exiled, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fourth of the month, Evil-merodach king of Babylon, in the year when he reigned, lifted up the head of Jehoiakim king of Judah and brought him out from the house in which he was kept.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he spoke good things to him and gave his throne above the thrones of the kings with him in Babylon.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he changed his prison garment, and he ate bread continually before his face all the days that he lived.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the ration for him was given continually from the king of Babylon, from day to day until the day he died.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened after Israel was taken captive and Jerusalem was made desolate, Jeremiah sat weeping and lamented this lament over Jerusalem and said,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: How the city sat alone, she who had been filled with peoples. She became like a widow, she who had been great among the nations; ruler among regions, she became subject to tribute.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Weeping, she wept in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; there is no one comforting her among all who love her. All her friends acted faithlessly toward her; they became enemies to her.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Judah was exiled because of her affliction and because of the multitude of her slavery. She sat among nations and found no rest. All who pursued her overtook her in the midst of those afflicting her.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The roads of Zion mourn because none come to the feast. All her gates are ruined. Her priests groan. Her virgins are led away, and she is embittered within herself.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Those afflicting her became the head, and her enemies prospered, because the Lord humbled her for the multitude of her ungodlinesses. Her little ones went into captivity before the face of the afflicter.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all her beauty went out from daughter Zion. Her rulers became like rams finding no pasture, and they went in no strength before the face of the pursuer.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Jerusalem remembered the days of her humiliation and her rejections, all her desirable things that were from ancient days, when her people fell into the hand of the afflicter and there was no helper for her. Her enemies saw her and laughed at her deportation.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Jerusalem sinned a sin; therefore she became a shaking. All who glorified her humbled her, for they saw her shame, and she herself, groaning, turned backward.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Her uncleanness is before her feet. She did not remember her end, and she lowered her boastful words. There is no one comforting her. See, Lord, my humiliation, because the enemy magnified himself.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The afflicter spread out his hand upon all her desirable things, for she saw nations entering her sanctuary, whom you commanded not to enter into your assembly.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All her people groan, seeking bread. They gave their desirable things for food, to restore life. See, Lord, and look, because I became dishonored.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Is it nothing to you, all who pass along the road? Turn and see if there is pain like my pain, which happened to me. The Lord, who spoke in me, humbled me in the day of the anger of his wrath.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: From his height he sent fire into my bones and brought it down. He spread a net for my feet. He turned me back. He made me desolate, pained all day.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He kept watch over my ungodlinesses; they were woven together in my hands and went up upon my neck. My strength weakened, because the Lord gave pains into my hands. I cannot stand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My eye brought down water, because the comforter restoring my soul was far from me. My sons became desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Zion spread out her hands; there is no one comforting her. The Lord commanded those afflicting Jacob around him. Jerusalem became like one sitting apart among them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The Lord is righteous, because I provoked his mouth. Hear now, all peoples, and see my pain. My virgins and my young men went into captivity.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I called my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders failed in the city, because they sought food for themselves to restore their souls and did not find it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: See, Lord, because I am afflicted. My inward parts were disturbed, and my heart turned within me, because in embittering I embittered. Outside, a sword bereaved me; inside the house like death.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hear now, because I groan. There is no one comforting me. All my enemies heard my evils and rejoiced because you did it. You brought a day; you called a time, and they became like me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let all their evil enter before your face, and glean them as they made a gleaning for all my sins, because my groans are many and my heart is grieved.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The Lord submerged all the beautiful things of Jacob without sparing. He pulled down in his wrath the strongholds of daughter Judah. He stuck them to the ground. He profaned her king and her rulers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point while supplying the expected English article before Lord.

trigger_phrase: He broke, in the anger of his wrath, every horn of Israel. He turned back his right hand from the face of the enemy, and he kindled in Jacob like a flame of fire that devoured all around.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He bent his bow like an enemy; he fixed his right hand like an adversary and killed all the desirable things of my eyes. In the tent of daughter Zion he poured out his wrath like fire.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The Lord became like an enemy. He submerged Israel. He submerged all her palaces. He destroyed his strongholds and multiplied humiliation and humbling for daughter Judah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The Lord cast off his altar, shook off his sanctuary, and broke the wall of her palaces by the hand of the enemy. They gave voice in the house of the Lord as on a feast day.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point while supplying the expected English article before Lord.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord turned to destroy the wall of daughter Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not turn back his hand from trampling. Rampart and wall mourned together; they weakened as one.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The elders of daughter Zion sat on the ground and kept silent. They raised dust on their heads and girded themselves with sackcloth. The chief virgins in Jerusalem brought themselves down to the ground.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My eyes failed with tears. My heart was troubled. My glory poured out on the earth over the crushing of the daughter of my people, when infant and suckling failed in the streets of the city.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: To their mothers they said, Where are grain and wine? as they failed like wounded ones in the streets of the city, as their souls poured out into the bosom of their mothers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What shall I testify to you, or what shall I compare to you, daughter Jerusalem? Who will save and comfort you, virgin daughter Zion? For the cup of your crushing became great; who will heal you?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your prophets saw for you vain and foolish things, and they did not uncover your injustice to turn back your captivity, but they saw for you vain burdens and expulsions.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All who pass along the road clapped hands over you. They hissed and shook their heads over daughter Jerusalem: Is this the city they called the crown of glory, joy of all the earth?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All your enemies opened their mouth over you. They hissed and gnashed teeth. They said, We swallowed her up. Yet this is the day we expected; we found it; we saw it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The Lord did what he intended. He fulfilled his words which he commanded from ancient days. He pulled down and did not spare. He made the enemy rejoice over you. He raised the horn of the one afflicting you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Their heart cried to the Lord. Walls of Zion, bring down tears like torrents day and night. Give yourself no relief. Let your eye not be silent.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Rise, cry out in the night, at the beginnings of your watch. Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift your hands to him for the life of your little ones, those failing from famine at the head of every street.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: See, Lord, and look: against whom have you gleaned thus? Will women eat the fruit of their womb? The cook made a gleaning. Will nursing infants be killed? Will you kill priest and prophet in the sanctuary of the Lord?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Young boy and elder lay down in the street. My virgins and my young men went into captivity. By sword and famine you killed. In the day of your anger you butchered; you did not spare.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You called my sojourners around as on a feast day, and in the day of the Lord's anger there was no one saved and left, though I had strengthened and multiplied all my enemies.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I am the man seeing poverty by the rod of his wrath upon me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He took me and led me into darkness, and not light.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Only against me he turned his hand all day.
