trigger_phrase: And go, enter into the captivity, to the sons of your people, and speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord, whether perhaps they hear, whether perhaps they yield.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of great shaking: Blessed be the glory of the Lord from his place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I perceived the sound of wings of living beings beating one against another, and the sound of the wheels next to them, and the sound of the shaking.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And spirit lifted me and took me up, and I went in the rush of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord became strong upon me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I entered into the captivity, borne aloft, and went around those dwelling by the river Chebar, those who were there, and sat there seven days, staying in the midst of them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened after the seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, I have given you as a watchman to the house of Israel, and you will hear a word from my mouth and warn them from me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When I say to the lawless one, By death you will be put to death, and you do not warn him nor speak to warn the lawless one to turn from his ways so that he may live, that lawless one will die in his injustice, and his blood I will seek from your hand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, if you warn the lawless one and he does not turn from his lawlessness and from his way, that lawless one will die in his injustice, and you will rescue your soul.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And when a righteous one turns from his righteousnesses and commits a trespass, and I set torment before his face, he will die because you did not warn him, and in his sins he will die because his righteous deeds that he did will not be remembered, and his blood I will seek from your hand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But if you warn the righteous one not to sin and he does not sin, the righteous one will surely live because you warned him, and you will rescue your own soul.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the hand of the Lord came upon me and said to me, Rise and go out into the plain, and there it will be spoken to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I rose and went out into the plain, and behold, there the glory of the Lord stood, just as the vision and as the glory that I had seen by the river Chebar, and I fell on my face.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And spirit came upon me and set me on my feet and spoke to me and said to me, Enter and shut yourself in the midst of your house.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, behold, bonds have been given upon you, and they will bind you with them, and you will not go out from the midst of them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will bind your tongue, and you will be made mute, and you will not be to them a man who rebukes, because it is a provoking house.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you will say to them, Thus says the Lord. The one who hears, let him hear; and the one who disobeys, let him disobey, because it is a provoking house.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, take for yourself a brick and set it before your face and draw on it a city, Jerusalem.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And set a siege against it and build defenses against it, and cast a siege mound around it, and set camps against it, and place siege engines around it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, take for yourself an iron pan and set it as an iron wall between you and the city, and prepare your face against it, and it will be under siege and you will shut it in. This is a sign for the sons of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will lie on your left side and set the injustices of the house of Israel upon it. According to the number of the days, one hundred fifty, during which you lie on it, you will bear their injustices.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I have given you their two injustices for the number of days, one hundred ninety days, and you will bear the injustices of the house of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will finish all these things and lie on your right side and bear the injustices of the house of Judah forty days. I have set for you a day for a year.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And toward the siege of Jerusalem you will prepare your face, and you will strengthen your arm, and you will prophesy against it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I, behold, have given bonds upon you, and you will not turn from one side to the other until the days of your siege are completed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, take for yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt and put them into an earthen vessel and make them for yourself into loaves, and according to the number of the days during which you sleep on your side, one hundred ninety days, you will eat them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And your food which you will eat will be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you will eat them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will drink water by measure, one-sixth of a hin. From time to time you will drink.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will eat them as a barley cake. With human-dung fuel you will bake them before their eyes.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will say, Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Thus the sons of Israel will eat unclean things among the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I said, No indeed, Lord God of Israel. Behold, my soul has not been defiled with uncleanness, and I have not eaten what died of itself or was torn by beasts from my birth until now, nor has any stale flesh entered into my mouth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Behold, I have given you cow dung instead of human dung, and you will make your loaves upon it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, behold, I break the support of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and in want, and they will drink water by measure and in ruin,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so that they may be in want of bread and water, and a man and his brother will be brought to ruin and melt away in their injustices.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, take for yourself a sharp sword, like a barber's razor. Acquire it for yourself and bring it over your head and over your beard, and you will take scales for weighing and divide the hairs.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: A quarter you will burn with fire in the midst of the city according to the completion of days of the siege. And you will take a quarter and burn it in the midst of her, and a quarter you will cut with a sword around her, and a quarter you will scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword behind them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will take from there a few in number and wrap them in your cloak.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And from these you will take again and throw them into the midst of the fire and burn them with fire. From it fire will go out, and you will say to all the house of Israel,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem. I have set her and the lands around her in the midst of the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will declare my ordinances to the lawless one from the nations and my statutes to the lands around her, because they rejected my ordinances and did not walk in my statutes.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because your occasion for sin was from the nations around you, and you did not walk in my statutes or do my ordinances, and you did not even do according to the ordinances of the nations around you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, and I will do judgment in your midst before the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will do among you things that I have not done, and things like these I will not do again, because of all your abominations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore fathers will eat children in your midst and children will eat fathers, and I will execute judgments in you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore as I live, says the Lord, because you defiled my holy things with all your abominations, I also will reject you. My eye will not spare, and I will not have mercy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: A quarter of you will be consumed in death, and a quarter of you will be finished in famine in your midst, and a quarter of you I will scatter to every wind, and a quarter of you will fall by sword around you, and I will draw out a sword behind them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my wrath and my anger will be completed upon them, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in my zeal when I complete my anger upon them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make you a wilderness, and your daughters around you, before everyone passing through.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will be groaned over and miserable among the nations around you when I execute judgments in you in vengeance of my wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When I send my arrows of famine upon them and they will be for destruction, and I will break your support of bread,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and I will send upon you famine and evil beasts and take vengeance on you, and death and blood will pass through upon you, and I will bring a sword upon you all around. I, the Lord, have spoken.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the valleys: Behold, I bring a sword upon you, and your high places will be destroyed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And your altars will be crushed and your shrines will be broken down, and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will scatter your bones around your altars.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In all your dwelling places the cities will be laid waste and the high places will disappear, so that your altars may be destroyed and your idols crushed and your shrines removed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the slain will fall in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When there are survivors from you from the sword among the nations, and when you are scattered in the lands,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then those of you who are rescued will remember me among the nations where they were taken captive, because I swore against their heart whoring away from me and against their eyes whoring after their practices, and they will beat their faces over all their abominations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Clap with your hand and stamp with your foot and say, Alas, alas, over all the abominations of the house of Israel. By sword and by death and by famine they will fall.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The one near will fall by sword, and the one far off will die by death, and the one hemmed in will be finished by famine, and I will complete my anger upon them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will know that I am the Lord when your slain are in the midst of your idols, around your altars, on every high hill and under every shady tree, where they offered a fragrant smell to all their idols.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land into desolation and ruin, from the wilderness to Diblath, in all their dwelling places, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel: The end has come; the end has come upon the four wings of the land.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The end has come.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Upon you who dwell in the land, the time has come; the day has drawn near, not with tumults nor with birth pains.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Now from nearby I will pour out my wrath upon you and complete my anger in you, and I will judge you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy, because I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord, the one who strikes.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Now the end comes toward you, and I will send it upon you, and I will take vengeance on you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: My eye will not spare you, nor will I show mercy, because I will bring your way upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For thus says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, the end has come. Behold, the day of the Lord. Though the rod has blossomed, insolence has sprung up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will shatter the staff of the lawless one, not with tumult nor with haste.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The time has come; behold, the day. Let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not mourn.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For the buyer will never return to the seller, and no one, with the eye of his life, will hold firm.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Sound the trumpet and judge everything.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: War with sword outside, and famine and death inside. The one in the field will die by sword, but famine and death will finish those in the city.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And those rescued from them will be saved and be on the mountains. I will kill all of them, each in his injustices.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All hands will grow weak, and all thighs will be defiled with wetness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will gird themselves with sackcloth, and dismay will cover them, and shame will be upon every face, and baldness upon every head.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Their silver will be thrown in the streets and their gold will be despised. Their souls will not be filled, and their bellies will not be satisfied, because it became a torment of their injustices.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Their chosen ornaments they set for pride, and images of their abominations they made from them; because of this I gave them over to uncleanness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will hand them over into the hands of strangers to plunder them, and to the pests of the earth for spoil, and they will profane them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will turn my face away from them, and they will defile my visitation, and they will enter them unguarded and profane them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will make confusion, because the land is full of peoples and the city is full of lawlessness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will turn away the arrogance of their strength, and their holy things will be defiled.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Propitiation will come, and one will seek peace, and it will not be.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Woe upon woe will be, and message upon message will be, and a vision will be sought from a prophet, and law will perish from a priest and counsel from elders.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: A ruler will clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be paralyzed. According to their ways I will deal with them, and by their judgments I will take vengeance on them, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in the house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, and the hand of the Lord came upon me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I saw, and behold, the likeness of a man: from his loins and downward, there was fire, and from his loins upward, like the appearance of electrum.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he stretched out the likeness of a hand and took me by the top of my head, and a spirit lifted me between the earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in the vision of God, to the forecourt of the inner gate facing north, where the pillar of the Possessor was.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And behold, there was the glory of the Lord God of Israel, according to the vision I saw in the plain.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, lift your eyes toward the north. And I lifted my eyes toward the north, and behold, from the north, toward the gate that faces east.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what these are doing? Great lawless deeds they do here, so that I should withdraw from my holy things, and still you will see greater lawless deeds.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he brought me to the forecourt of the court.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, dig. And I dug, and behold, one door.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Enter and see the lawless deeds that these do here.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I entered and saw, and behold, vain abominations and all idols of the house of Israel engraved on it all around.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel stood before them, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was in the midst of them, and each had his censer in his hand, and the vapor of the incense was going up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do, each in his hidden chamber? For they said, The Lord does not see; the Lord has abandoned the land.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, You will still see greater lawless deeds that these do.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he brought me to the forecourt of the gate of the house of the Lord that faces north, and behold, women were sitting there lamenting Tammuz.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen? You will still see practices greater than these.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord, and behold, at the forecourt of the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, about twenty men had their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces opposite, and these were bowing to the sun.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Have you seen, son of man? Is it a small thing for the house of Judah to do the lawless deeds they have done here? For they filled the land with lawlessness, and behold, they are like mockers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I also will deal with them in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have mercy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he cried into my ears with a loud voice, saying, The vengeance of the city has drawn near, and each had the instruments of destruction in his hand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate that faces north, and each one's axe was in his hand, and one man was in the midst of them, clothed in a full-length robe, with a sapphire belt on his loins; and they entered and stood beside the bronze altar.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the glory of God of Israel went up from the cherubim that was upon them to the forecourt of the house, and he called the man clothed in the full-length robe, who had the belt upon his loins.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to him, Pass through the midst of Jerusalem and put the mark on the foreheads of the men who groan and grieve over all the lawless deeds being done in her midst.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And to these he said in my hearing, Go after him into the city and strike. Let not your eyes spare, and do not show mercy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Kill old man and young man and virgin and infants and women for wiping out, but do not come near anyone on whom the mark is, and begin from my holy things. And they began from the elder men who were inside the house.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to them, Defile the house and fill the ways with the dead. Go out and strike.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened while they were striking that I fell on my face and cried out and said, Alas, Lord, do you wipe out the remnant of Israel when you pour out your wrath upon Jerusalem?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, The injustice of the house of Israel and Judah has grown very, very great, because the land has been filled with many peoples and the city has been filled with injustice and uncleanness, because they said, The Lord has abandoned the land; the Lord does not look upon it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy. I have put their ways on their heads.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And behold, the man clothed in the full-length robe, with the belt around his loins, answered, saying, I have done just as you commanded me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I saw, and behold, above the firmament over the heads of the cherubim, like a sapphire stone, there was the likeness of a throne upon them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to the man clothed in the robe, Enter into the midst of the wheels beneath the cherubim and fill your hands with coals of fire from the midst of the cherubim and scatter them over the city. And he entered before me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the cherubim stood on the right of the house when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the glory of the Lord went up from the cherubim to the forecourt of the house, and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the sound of wings of cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty speaking.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I saw on the cherubim the likeness of human hands beneath their wings.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I saw, and behold, four wheels stood beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of a carbuncle stone.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And their backs and their hands and their wings and the wheels were full of eyes all around the four wheels.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And as for these wheels, they were called Whirling, as I heard.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the cherubim were lifted up. This was the living creature I saw by the river Chebar.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them, and when the cherubim lifted their wings to rise from the earth, their wheels did not turn.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When they stood, these stood, and when they were lifted up, these were lifted with them, because the spirit of life was in them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the glory of the Lord went out from the house and settled on the cherubim.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the cherubim lifted their wings and were raised from the earth before me as they went out, and the wheels were beside them, and they stood at the forecourt of the opposite gate of the house of the Lord, and the glory of God of Israel was above them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: This is the living creature I saw beneath God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I knew that they are cherubim.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the likeness of their faces: these are the faces I saw beneath the glory of God of Israel by the river Chebar, and each went straight before its face.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And a spirit took me up and brought me to the opposite gate of the house of the Lord that faces east, and behold, at the forecourt of the gate were about twenty-five men. And I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord said to me, Son of man, these are the men thinking vain things and counseling evil counsel in this city,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: those saying, Have not the houses recently been built? This is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me and said to me, Say, Thus says the Lord: Thus you said, house of Israel, and the plans of your spirit I know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You multiplied your dead in this city and filled its streets with slain.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Your dead, whom you struck in its midst, these are the meat and this is the cooking pot, but I will bring you out from its midst.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You fear the sword, and a sword I will bring upon you, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will bring you out from its midst and hand you over into the hands of strangers, and I will execute judgments among you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: By a sword you will fall. On the borders of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: This will not be the cooking pot for you, and you will certainly not become meat in its midst. On the borders of Israel I will judge you,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened, while I prophesied, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died, and I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, Alas, alas, Lord, are you bringing the remnant of Israel to an end?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and all the house of Israel have come to the full, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem said, Keep far from the Lord; to us the land was given for inheritance.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Though I thrust them away among the nations and scatter them into all the earth, yet I will be to them as a little sanctuary in the lands into which they enter.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: I will welcome them from the nations and gather them from the lands where I scattered them, and I will give them the land of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will enter there and remove all its abominations and all its lawless deeds from it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will give them another heart, and I will give a new spirit within them, and I will pull out the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so that they may walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them, and they will be to me for a people and I will be to them for God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But as for the heart set on their abominations and their lawless deeds, as their heart went after them, I have put their ways on their heads, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the cherubim lifted their wings, and the wheels were beside them, and the glory of God of Israel was above them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain opposite the city.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And a spirit took me up and brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision, in the Spirit of God, and I came up from the vision that I saw.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord that he showed me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their injustices, those who have eyes to see and do not see, and ears to hear and do not hear, because it is a provoking house.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, make for yourself baggage for captivity by day before them, and you will go into captivity from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because it is a provoking house.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will bring out your baggage, like baggage for captivity, by day in their sight, and you will go out in the evening, as a captive goes out.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In their sight dig for yourself through the wall, and you will go out through it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In their sight you will be lifted on shoulders and go out hidden. You will cover your face so that you do not see the land, because I have given you as a wonder to the house of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I did so, according to everything he commanded me, and I brought out baggage like baggage for captivity by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself, and hidden I went out; I was lifted on shoulders in their sight.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, did not the house of Israel, the provoking house, say to you, What are you doing?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Say to them, Thus says the Lord God concerning the ruler and the leader in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are in their midst.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Say, I perform wonders in her midst. As I have done, so it will be to them; into exile and captivity they will go.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the ruler in their midst will be lifted on shoulders and will go out hidden. Through the wall he will dig to go out through it. He will cover his face so that he is not seen by any eye, and he will not see the land.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my enclosure, and I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans, and yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all those around him, his helpers and all those supporting him, I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw out a sword behind them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will know that I am the Lord, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the lands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will leave from them a few men in number, from sword and famine and death, so that they may recount all their lawless deeds among the nations where they entered, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, you will eat your bread with pain, and you will drink your water with torment and distress.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord to those dwelling in Jerusalem upon the land of Israel: They will eat their bread with scarcity and drink their water with desolation, so that the land may be desolated with its fullness, because of the impiety of all those dwelling in it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And their inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will become a desolation, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, what is this proverb among you on the land of Israel, saying, The days are far off; the vision has perished?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord: I will turn away this proverb, and the house of Israel will no longer speak this proverb. But speak to them, The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For there will no longer be any false vision and any flattering diviner in the midst of the sons of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because I am the Lord. I will speak my words; I will speak and do them, and I will delay no longer, because in your days, provoking house, I will speak the word and do it, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, behold, the provoking house of Israel says, The vision that this one sees is for many days, and for distant times this one prophesies.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord: None of my words will be delayed any longer. Whatever word I speak, I will speak and do, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and you will prophesy and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those prophesying from their own heart and seeing nothing at all.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the deserts.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They did not stand in firmness and gathered flocks against the house of Israel. Those speaking did not rise in the day of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Seeing false things and divining vain things, those saying, The Lord says, though the Lord did not send them, and they began to establish a word.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Did you not see a false vision and speak vain divinations?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will stretch out my hand against the prophets seeing false things and those uttering vanities. In the instruction of my people they will not be, nor will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, nor will they enter into the land of Israel, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because they led my people astray, saying, Peace, peace, and there was no peace, and one builds a wall, and they plaster it; it will fall.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Say to those plastering it, It will fall, and there will be flooding rain, and I will give hailstones against their bindings, and they will fall, and there will be a storming wind, and it will be broken.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And behold, the wall has fallen, and will they not say to you, Where is your plaster that you plastered?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will burst forth a storming blast with wrath, and flooding rain will come in my anger, and hailstones in wrath I will bring for complete destruction.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will tear down the wall that you plastered, and it will fall, and I will lay it on the ground, and its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be finished with reproofs, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will complete my wrath against the wall and against those plastering it, and it will fall, and I will say to you, The wall is not, nor are those plastering it,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: the prophets of Israel prophesying concerning Jerusalem and seeing peace for her, though there is no peace, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, Thus says the Lord: Woe to those stitching cushions on every elbow of the hand and making veils over every head of every stature, to twist souls. The souls of my people were twisted, and they kept souls alive for themselves.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they profaned me before my people for a handful of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill souls that should not die and to keep souls alive that should not live, when you utter vain utterances to a people listening.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against your cushions on which you twist souls there, and I will tear them from your arms and send away the souls that you twist, their souls into scattering.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will tear your veils and rescue my people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hands for twisting, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because you twisted the heart of a righteous one unjustly, and I did not twist him, and because you strengthened the hands of a lawless one so that he not turn at all from his evil way and live,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: therefore you will never see false things, and you will never divine divinations again, and I will rescue my people from your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And men from the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, these men set their thoughts upon their hearts and placed punishment of their injustices before their face. Shall I indeed answer them?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord: Any man, any man from the house of Israel, who sets his thoughts upon his heart and places punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to the prophet, I, the Lord, will answer him in the things wherein his mind is entangled,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so as to turn aside the house of Israel according to their hearts that are alienated from me in their thoughts.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God: Turn back and turn away from your practices and from all your impieties, and turn your faces back.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because any man, any man from the house of Israel and from the newcomers sojourning in Israel, who becomes alienated from me and sets his thoughts upon his heart and places punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to the prophet to inquire of him in me, I, the Lord, will answer him in that wherein he is entangled within himself.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will set my face against that man and make him a desolation and a ruin, and I will remove him from the midst of my people, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if a prophet is led astray and speaks, I, the Lord, have led that prophet astray, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will bear their injustice; like the offense of the one inquiring, so the offense of the prophet will be,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so that the house of Israel may no longer wander from me, and so that they may no longer be defiled in all their trespasses, and they will be to me for a people and I will be to them for God, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, if a land sins against me by committing offense, and I stretch out my hand against it and break its support of bread and send famine upon it and remove from it man and cattle,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and if these three men are in its midst, Noah and Daniel and Job, they themselves will be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if I bring evil beasts upon the land and punish it, and it becomes a desolation and there is no passerby because of the beasts,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be saved; only they themselves will be saved, but the land will become a ruin.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Or if I bring a sword upon that land and say, Let a sword pass through the land, and I remove from it man and cattle,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, they will never rescue sons or daughters; only they themselves will be saved.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Or if I send death upon that land and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to destroy from it man and cattle,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and Noah and Daniel and Job are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be left behind; they themselves will rescue their own souls by their righteousness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Even if I send my four evil punishments, sword and famine and evil beasts and death, upon Jerusalem, to destroy from it man and cattle,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: yet behold, survivors are left in it, its rescued ones, who bring out sons and daughters from it. Behold, they come out to you, and you will see their ways and their thoughts, and you will regret the evils that I brought upon Jerusalem, all the evils that I brought upon her.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will comfort you, because you will see their ways and their thoughts, and you will know that I have not done in vain all that I did in her, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, what might become of the wood of the vine, from all the wood of the branches that are among the trees of the forest?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will wood be taken from it to make something for work? Will a peg be taken from it to hang any vessel on it?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: It is only given to the fire for consuming; the fire consumes the yearly pruning from it, and it fails completely. Will it be useful for any work?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make the land a desolation, because they committed an offense, says the Lord.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

trigger_phrase: Son of man, bear witness to Jerusalem concerning her lawless deeds,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And as for your birth, on the day you were born they did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water, nor salted with salt, nor wrapped in swaddling-cloths.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I passed by you and saw you mixed in your blood, and I said to you, From your blood, life.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Increase; I made you like the growth of the field, and you multiplied and grew great and entered into the cities of cities. Your breasts were raised and your hair sprang up, but you were naked and unseemly.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I passed by you and saw you, and behold, your time, a time of resting. And I spread my wings over you and covered your nakedness and swore to you and entered into covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became mine.
