trigger_phrase: And I washed you with water and washed away your blood from you and anointed you with oil.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I clothed you with embroidered things and shod you with hyacinth and girded you with fine linen and wrapped you with hair-woven cloth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I adorned you with jewelry and put bracelets on your hands and a necklace around your neck.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I put a nose-ring on your nostril and rings on your ears and a crown of boasting on your head.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you were adorned with gold and silver, and your garments were fine linen and hair-woven and embroidered. You ate fine flour and oil and honey, and you became exceedingly beautiful.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And your name went out among the nations because of your beauty, because it was completed in splendor, in the beauty that I set upon you, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you trusted in your beauty and whored because of your name and poured out your whoring on every passerby, which should not be.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you took from your garments and made for yourself stitched idols and whored on them, and you shall never enter, nor shall it happen.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you took vessels of your boasting from my gold and my silver, from what I gave you, and made for yourself male images and whored with them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you took your embroidered garment and clothed them, and my oil and my incense you set before them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my breads that I gave you, fine flour and oil and honey with which I fed you, you set before them for fragrant smell, and it happened, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore and sacrificed them to them for destruction. You whored as if it were a small thing.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you slaughtered your children and gave them up as you made expiation with them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: This was beyond all your whoring, and you did not remember the days of your infancy, when you were naked and unseemly and lived while mixed in your blood.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened after all your evils, says the Lord,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: that you built for yourself a house of prostitution and made for yourself a display-place in every square.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And at the head of every road you built your brothels and ruined your beauty and spread your legs to every passerby and multiplied your whoring.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you whored with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, great of flesh, and you whored in many ways to provoke me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if I stretch out my hand against you and remove your statutes and hand you over to the souls of those hating you, daughters of foreigners, who turned you aside from your way in which you acted impiously,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then you whored with daughters of Assyria, and not even thus were you satisfied, and you whored, and still were not filled.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you multiplied your covenants toward the land of the Chaldeans, and not even with these were you satisfied.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What shall I do with your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these works of a prostitute woman, and you whored threefold?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Among your daughters you built your brothel at the head of every road and made your base in every square, and you became like a prostitute gathering wages.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The adulterous woman is like you, taking wages from her husband.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: She gave wages to all those who prostituted her, but you gave wages to all your lovers and loaded them down to come to you from all around in your whoring.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And in you there came to be perversity beyond the women in your whoring: they whored with you when you gave wages, and wages were not given to you, and perverse things came to be in you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore, whore, hear the word of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Because you poured out your bronze, and your shame will be uncovered in your whoring toward your lovers and toward all the thoughts of your lawless deeds and in the blood of your children whom you gave to them,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: therefore behold, I gather all your lovers with whom you mixed, and all whom you loved, with all whom you hated, and I will gather them against you from all around and uncover your evils before them, and they will see all your shame.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will avenge you with the vengeance of adulteress and one shedding blood, and I will set you in the blood of wrath and jealousy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will hand you over into their hands, and they will tear down your brothel and pull down your base and strip you of your garment and take vessels of your boasting and leave you naked and unseemly.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will bring crowds against you and stone you with stones and butcher you with their swords.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will burn your houses with fire and do vengeance on you before many women, and I will turn you from your whoring, and you will give wages no longer.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will let my wrath rest on you and my jealousy will depart from you, and I will rest and no longer be troubled.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because you did not remember the day of your infancy and grieved me in all these things, behold, I also have put your ways on your head, says the Lord, and so you did impiety on top of all your lawless deeds.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: These are all the things they spoke against you in a proverb, saying, Like mother, like daughter.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You are daughter of your mother, who rejected her husband and her children, and sister of your sisters, who rejected their husbands and their children. Your mother was Hittite, and your father was Amorite.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters dwelling on your left, and your younger sister dwelling on your right is Sodom and her daughters.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And not in their ways did you walk, nor did you act according to their lawless deeds. It was a small thing, and you surpassed them in all your ways.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As I live, says the Lord, Sodom your sister and her daughters did not do as you and your daughters did.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Except this was the lawlessness of Sodom your sister: pride, fullness of bread, and abundance of wine belonged to her and her daughters, and they did not support the hand of the poor and needy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they were boasting and did lawless things before me, and I removed them as I saw.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Samaria did not sin according to half of your sins, and you multiplied your lawless deeds beyond them and justified your sisters by all your lawless deeds that you did.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you bear your torment, because you corrupted your sisters with your sins by which you acted more lawlessly than they, and you justified them beyond yourself. And you, be ashamed and receive your dishonor in justifying your sisters.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will turn back their turning back, the turning back of Sodom and her daughters, and I will turn back the turning back of Samaria and her daughters, and I will turn back your turning back in their midst,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so that you bear your torment and be dishonored for everything you did in provoking me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And your sister Sodom and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning, and Samaria and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning, and you and your daughters will be restored as you were from the beginning.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Sodom your sister was not mentioned in your mouth in the days of your pride,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: before your evils were uncovered, as now you are a reproach of the daughters of Syria and of all those around her, daughters of foreigners encircling you around,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: your impieties and your lawless deeds, you yourself have borne them, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: I will act in you as you acted, as you dishonored these things by transgressing my covenant.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your infancy and raise up for you an everlasting covenant.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will remember your way and be utterly dishonored when you receive your older sisters with your younger ones, and I will give them to you for building, and not from your covenant.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will raise my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: so that you remember and be ashamed and no longer have it in you to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I make propitiation for you according to all that you did, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, tell a tale and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, large-winged, long in spread, full of claws, having power to enter Lebanon, came and took the choice things of the cedar.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He clipped off the tips of its tenderness and brought them into the land of Canaan; in a fortified city he set them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he took from the seed of the land and put it in the open field, a plant by much water; under watch he set it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it sprang up and became a vine, weak and small in size, with its branches appearing upon it and its roots beneath it, and it became a vine and made shoots and sent out its tendril-growth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And there was another great eagle, large-winged and many-clawed, and behold, this vine was entwined toward him, and its roots toward him, and its branches it sent out toward him so that he might water it with the clod of its planting.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In a good field by much water it fattens, to make shoots and bear fruit, to become a great vine.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not its tender roots and its fruit rot, and all its first sproutings dry up? Not with great arm, nor with many people, to pull it from its roots.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And behold, it fattens. Will it prosper? Will it not dry in drought as soon as the scorching wind touches it? With the clod of its growth it will dry up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, now say to the provoking house, Do you not understand what these things were? Say, When the king of Babylon comes against Jerusalem and takes its king and its rulers and brings them to himself in Babylon,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then he will take from the seed of the kingdom and make a covenant with him and bring him under a curse, and he will take the leaders of the land,

trigger_phrase: that the kingdom may become weak, not lifting itself up at all, but keeping his covenant and standing by it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But he will rebel against him by sending his own messengers into Egypt, so that it might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one acting as an adversary and transgressing the covenant be saved?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As I live, says the Lord, surely in the place of the king who made him king, who dishonored my oath and who transgressed my covenant with him, in the midst of Babylon he will die.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Pharaoh will not make war for him with great force nor with a great crowd, by casting up a trench and building missile-stations, to cut off lives.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he dishonored an oath by transgressing a covenant, and behold, he gave his hand and did all these things. He will not be saved.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore say, Thus says the Lord: As I live, surely my covenant that he transgressed and my oath that he dishonored, I will put them on his head.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in its enclosure.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In all his battle line they will fall by sword, and those left I will scatter to every wind, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because thus says the Lord: I myself will take from the choice things of the cedar, from the top of their heart I will clip off and plant it upon a high mountain and hang it there.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: On a high mountain of Israel I will plant it, and it will bring forth a shoot and make fruit and become a great cedar, and every beast and every bird will rest beneath it; in its shade its branches will be restored.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all the trees of the field will know that I am the Lord, humbling the high tree and exalting the low tree and drying the green tree and making the dry tree flourish. I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, what is this proverb for you among the sons of Israel, saying, The fathers ate an unripe grape, and the teeth of the children were set on edge?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As I live, says the Lord, this proverb will no longer be spoken in Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because all the souls are mine. As the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son, they are mine. The soul that sins, it will die.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the man who is righteous, who does judgment and righteousness,

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will not oppress a man; he will return the pledge of a debtor and will not seize plunder; he will give his bread to the hungry one and clothe the naked one.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he will not give his money on interest, nor take excess, and he will turn his hand away from injustice; he will do righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he has walked in my ordinances and kept my judgments to do them. This one is righteous; living he will live, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And if he fathers a violent son, shedding blood and committing sins,

trigger_phrase: who did not walk in the way of his righteous father, but also ate on the mountains and defiled the wife of his neighbor,

trigger_phrase: and oppressed the poor and needy and seized plunder and did not return the pledge, and set his eyes on the idols and did lawlessness,

trigger_phrase: and gave with interest and took excess. Will this one live? He will not live. He did all these lawless deeds; by death he will be put to death. His blood will be upon him.

trigger_phrase: And if he fathers a son and he sees all the sins of his father that he did and fears and does not do according to them,

trigger_phrase: he has not eaten on the mountains and has not set his eyes on the thoughts of the house of Israel and has not defiled the wife of his neighbor,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and has not oppressed a man and has not taken a pledge and has not seized plunder; he gave his bread to the hungry one and clothed the naked one,

trigger_phrase: and turned his hand away from injustice; he did not take interest or excess, and did righteousness and walked in my ordinances. This one will not die in the injustices of his father; living he will live.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But his father, if he oppressed with oppression and seized plunder and did contrary things in the midst of my people, he will die in his injustice.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will say, Why has the son not borne the injustice of his father? Because the son did righteousness and mercy and kept all my ordinances and did them; living he will live.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: None of all his trespasses that he did will be remembered; in his righteousness that he did he will live.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

In his trespass by which he trespassed and in his sins by which he sinned, in them he will die.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, Thus says the Lord: Because your heart was exalted and you said, I am God; I have dwelt in the dwelling of God in the heart of the sea, but you are a man and not God, and you set your heart as the heart of God,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In your abundant knowledge and your trade you multiplied your power; your heart was exalted in your power.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you set your heart as the heart of God,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: because of this, behold, I bring against you foreign scourges from nations, and they will draw their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge, and they will lay your beauty down to destruction.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will bring you down, and you will die the death of the wounded in the heart of the sea.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Will you indeed say, I am God, before those killing you? But you are a man and not God among a multitude.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hands of foreigners, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, take up a lamentation over the ruler of Tyre and say to him, Thus says the Lord God: You are a seal of likeness and a crown of beauty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You came to be in the delight of the paradise of God. You clothed yourself with every precious stone: sardius and topaz and emerald and carbuncle and sapphire and jasper and silver and gold and ligurion and agate and amethyst and chrysolite and beryl and onyx; and with gold you filled your treasures and your storehouses within you from the day you were created.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: With the cherub I placed you on the holy mountain of God; you came to be in the midst of fiery stones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You were blameless in your days from the day you were created until injustices were found in you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: From the abundance of your trade you filled your storehouses with lawlessness and sinned, and you were wounded from the mountain of God, and the cherub led you out from the midst of fiery stones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Your heart was exalted because of your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted with your beauty. Because of the multitude of your sins I cast you upon the ground; before kings I gave you to be made an example.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because of the multitude of your sins and the injustices of your trade you profaned your holy things, and I will bring out fire from your midst; this will devour you, and I will give you as ashes on your land before all those seeing you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all those who know you among the nations will shudder over you; you became a destruction and will no longer exist forever.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you, and you will know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you and am sanctified in you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Blood and death will be in your streets, and wounded ones will fall by swords in you, all around you, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a thorn of bitterness and a pricking briar of pain from all those around them who dishonored them, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord God: And I will gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered, and I will be sanctified in them before the peoples and the nations, and they will dwell on their land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will dwell on it in hope and build houses and plant vineyards and dwell in hope, when I execute judgment against all those dishonoring them around them, and they will know that I am the Lord their God and the God of their fathers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, set your face toward Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, the great dragon sitting in the midst of his rivers, saying, The rivers are mine, and I made them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will put hooks in your jaws and fasten the fish of your river to your fins and bring you up from the midst of your river, and all the fish of your river,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and I will quickly cast you down upon the face of the plain, along with all the fish of your river. You will fall and not be gathered or collected; I have given you for food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all those inhabiting Egypt will know that I am the Lord, because you became a reed-staff for the house of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When they took hold of you with their hands, you were crushed, and when every hand seized hold on them and when they leaned on you, you were shattered and broke all their loins.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring a sword upon you and will destroy men and cattle from you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the land of Egypt will be a destruction and a wilderness, and they will know that I am the Lord, because you said, The rivers are mine, and I made them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore behold, I am against you and against all your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt a wilderness, a sword, and a destruction from Migdol and Syene and as far as the borders of the Ethiopians.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The foot of a man will not pass through it, and the foot of a beast will not pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make its land a destruction in the midst of a desolated land, and its cities will be desolated forty years in the midst of desolated cities, and I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the lands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and I will turn back the captivity of the Egyptians and settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were taken, and it will be a humble dominion.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Beyond all dominions it will no longer be exalted over the nations, and I will make them few, so that they will not be many among the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will no longer be for the house of Israel a hope recalling lawlessness when they follow after them, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, made his force serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was bald and every shoulder peeled raw, and no wages came to him or to his force from Tyre for the service that they served against her.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I give to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, the land of Egypt, and he will plunder its plunder and spoil its spoils, and it will be the wages for his force.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In return for the service with which he served against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt, thus says the Lord God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: On that day a horn will spring up for the whole house of Israel, and to you I will give an open mouth in their midst, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Woe, woe to the day,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: because the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of the end of nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And a sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia, and wounded ones will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the supports of Egypt will fall, and the arrogance of her strength will go down. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword in her, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be made desolate in the midst of desolated lands, and their cities will be desolated in the midst of desolated cities.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will know that I am the Lord when I send fire upon Egypt and all those helping her are crushed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: By his hand and by the hand of his people, scourges from nations sent to destroy the land, they will all draw their swords against Egypt, and the land will be filled with the wounded.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make their rivers desolate and destroy the land and its fullness by the hands of foreigners. I, the Lord, have spoken.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For thus says the Lord God: And I will destroy nobles from Memphis and rulers from the land of Egypt, and they will no longer be.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will destroy the land of Pathros and send fire upon Zoan and execute vengeance in Diospolis.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will pour out my wrath upon Sais, the strength of Egypt, and destroy the multitude of Memphis.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will send fire upon Egypt, and Syene will be troubled with turmoil, and there will be a breach in Diospolis, and waters will be poured out.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the women will go into captivity.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I break the scepters of Egypt there, and the arrogance of her strength will perish there, and a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will be led away captive.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, I broke the arms of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and behold, it was not bound up for healing, to have salve put on it, to be given strength to seize a sword.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and will break his strong and outstretched arms and cast his sword from his hand.

trigger_phrase: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the lands.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall, and they will know that I am the Lord when I give my sword into the hands of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out over the land of Egypt.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the lands, and they all will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because of this his stature was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his branches spread wide because of much water.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In his boughs all the birds of heaven nested, and under his branches all the beasts of the field gave birth; the whole multitude of nations dwelt in his shade.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he became beautiful in his height because of the multitude of his branches, because his roots reached much water.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: No cypresses like these were in the paradise of God, and pines were not like his boughs, and firs were not like his branches; no tree in the paradise of God was like him in his beauty.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because of the multitude of his branches, the trees of the paradise of God's delight envied him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you became great in stature and set your top into the midst of clouds, and I saw when he was exalted,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I delivered him into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he brought about his destruction.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And foreign scourges from nations destroyed him and cast him down upon the mountains; in all the ravines his branches fell, and his stems were broken in every plain of the land, and all the peoples of the nations came down from their shelter and laid him low.

trigger_phrase: Upon his fall all the birds of heaven rested, and upon his stems all the beasts of the field came,

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord God: On the day he went down to Hades, the deep mourned for him, and I restrained its rivers and held back much water, and Lebanon grew dark over him; all the trees of the field fainted over him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: And I will spread over you nets of many peoples and bring you up with my hook.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will stretch you out on the land; the plains will be filled with you, and I will make all the birds of heaven settle upon you, and from you I will fill all the beasts of the whole earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will put your flesh upon the mountains and fill them with your blood.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the land will be watered from your dung, from your multitude upon the mountains; I will fill ravines from you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All the shining lights in heaven will darken over you, and I will give darkness on your land, says the Lord God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will provoke the heart of many peoples when I lead your captivity among the nations to a land that you did not know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And many nations will shudder over you, and their kings will stand astonished when my sword flies before their faces, awaiting their fall from the day of your fall.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because thus says the Lord: The sword of the king of Babylon will come to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: With swords of giants I will bring down your strength; scourges from nations, all of them, will destroy the arrogance of Egypt, and all her strength will be crushed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will destroy all her cattle from beside much water, and a human foot will no longer trouble it, and the track of cattle will no longer trample it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will dwell on the land that I gave to your fathers, and you will be to me for a people and I will be to you for God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses and call for the grain and multiply it and I will not give famine upon you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field so that you no longer receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will remember your evil ways and your practices that were not good and loathe yourselves before your faces for your lawless deeds and for your abominations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Not for your sake do I act, says the Lord God; it will be made known to you. Be ashamed and be confounded from your ways, O house of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: On the day when I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds and cause the cities to be inhabited, the desolate places will be built,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and the land that was desolated will be worked, because it had become desolated before the eyes of every passerby.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will say, That land which was desolated became like a garden of delight, and the desolate and ruined and torn-down cities sat fortified.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the nations that are left around you will know that I, the Lord, built the torn-down places and planted the desolated places. I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord: Still for this I will be sought by the house of Israel, to do for them: I will multiply them like sheep, men.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As holy sheep, as the sheep of Jerusalem in her feasts, so the desolate cities will be filled with flocks of men, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and the Lord brought me out in the Spirit and set me in the midst of the plain, and it was full of human bones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he led me around over them, all around, and behold, they were very many on the face of the plain, very dry.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Son of man, will these bones live? And I said, O Lord, you know these things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Prophesy over these bones, and you will say to them, Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I am bringing the spirit of life into you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will put sinews on you and bring up flesh upon you and stretch skin over you and give my Spirit into you, and you will live, and you will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I prophesied as he commanded me, and it happened, while I prophesied, and behold, there was a shaking, and the bones came together, each to its joint.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I saw, and behold, sinews and flesh were growing upon them, and skin was rising over them above, but there was no spirit in them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he said to me, Prophesy, son of man, prophesy to the spirit, and say to the spirit, Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead ones, and let them live.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I prophesied as he commanded me, and the spirit entered into them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, a very great gathering.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord spoke to me, saying, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel, and they say, Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished, we are cut off.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I open your tombs and bring you up from your tombs and bring you into the land of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will know that I am the Lord when I open your graves, when I bring my people up from the graves.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will give my Spirit into you and you will live, and I will place you on your land, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, take for yourself a rod and write on it, Judah and the sons of Israel attached to him, and take for yourself a second rod and write on it, Joseph, rod of Ephraim, and all the sons of Israel added to him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And join them to one another for yourself into one rod, to bind them, and they will be in your hand.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be when the sons of your people say to you, Will you not tell us what these things are to you?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Then you will say to them, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I take the tribe of Joseph from the hand of Ephraim and the tribes of Israel attached to him, and I will place them upon the tribe of Judah, and they will be one rod in the hand of Judah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the rods on which you wrote will be in your hand before them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will say to them, Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I take the whole house of Israel from the midst of the nations where they entered there, and I will gather them from all those around them and bring them into the land of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make them one nation in my land and on the mountains of Israel, and one ruler will be over them, and they will no longer be two nations, nor be divided any longer into two kingdoms.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: So that they no longer may defile themselves with their idols, and I will rescue them from all their lawless deeds in which they sinned, and I will cleanse them, and they will be to me for a people, and I, the Lord, will be to them for God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my servant David will be ruler in their midst, and one shepherd will be for all, because they will walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will dwell on their land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt there, and they will dwell on it, they and David my servant, and he will be their ruler forever.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will make with them a covenant of peace; an everlasting covenant will be with them, and I will put my holy things in their midst forever.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my dwelling will be among them, and I will be to them for God, and they will be to me for a people.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when my holy things are in their midst forever.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Son of man, set your face toward Gog and the land of Magog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And say to him, Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen clothed in breastplates, all of them a great gathering, shields and helmets and swords,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Persians and Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and shields,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Gomer and all those around him, the house of Togarmah from the farthest north and all those around him, and many nations with you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Be prepared; prepare yourself, you and your whole assembly gathered with you, and you will be to me for a guard.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: After many days he will be prepared, and in latter years he will come and enter into the land brought back from the sword, with people gathered from many nations onto the land of Israel, which had become entirely desolate; and this people came out from nations, and they all will dwell in peace.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will come up like rain and arrive like a cloud to cover the land, you and all those around you, and many nations with you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord God: And it will be on that day, words will come up upon your heart, and you will devise evil plans,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and say, I will go up against a land thrown open; I will come against those quiet in stillness and dwelling in peace, all dwelling in a land where there is no wall, and neither bars nor gates are theirs,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: to plunder plunder and seize spoils, to turn your hand against the desolated place that was resettled, and against a nation gathered from many nations, making possessions, dwelling on the navel of the earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Carthage and all their villages will say to you, Is it for plunder that you have come, and to spoil spoils? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, to carry off possessions, to spoil spoils?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord: Is it not on that day, when my people Israel are settled in peace, that you will rise up?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will come from your place, from the farthest north, and many nations with you, all riding horses, a great assembly and much force.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will come up against my people Israel like a cloud to cover the land; it will be in the last days, and I will bring you upon my land so that all the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you before them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus says the Lord God to Gog: Are you the one concerning whom I spoke in former days through the hand of my servants, the prophets of Israel, in those days and years, to bring you upon them?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be on that day, on the day when Gog comes upon the land of Israel, says the Lord God, my wrath will rise up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And in my zeal, in the fire of my anger, I spoke: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon the land of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the beasts of the field and all the creeping things creeping on the earth and all humans on the face of the earth will be shaken from the face of the Lord, and the mountains will be split and the ravines will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will call against him every fear, says the Lord; a man's sword will be against his brother.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will judge him with death and blood and flooding rain and hailstones, and I will rain fire and sulfur upon him and upon all those with him and upon many nations with him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will be magnified and sanctified and glorified, and I will be known before many nations, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will gather you and lead you and bring you up from the farthest north and bring you upon the mountains of Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will destroy your bow from your left hand and your arrows from your right hand and cast you down.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Upon the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all those around you, and the nations that are with you will be given to multitudes of birds, to every bird; and I have given you to all the beasts of the field to be devoured.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Upon the face of the plain you will fall, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will send fire upon Gog, and the islands will be inhabited in peace, and they will know that I am the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And my holy name will be known in the midst of my people Israel, and my holy name will no longer be profaned, and the nations will know that I am the Lord, holy in Israel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Behold, it has come, and you will know that it will be, says the Lord God. This is the day in which I spoke.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the inhabitants of the cities of Israel will go out and burn the weapons, shields and spears and bows and arrows and hand-staves and lances, and they will keep fire burning with them for seven years.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will not take wood from the field nor cut from the forests, but rather they will burn the weapons with fire and plunder those who plundered them and spoil those who spoiled them, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be on that day, I will give Gog a notable place, a tomb in Israel, the burial place of those coming toward the sea; and they will wall up the mouth of the ravine and bury Gog there and all his multitude, and it will be called the Valley, Gog's Burial Place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the house of Israel will bury them so that the land may be cleansed in seven months.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all the people of the land will bury them, and it will be to them for renown on the day when I was glorified, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will appoint men continually to pass through the land, to bury those left on the face of the land and cleanse it; after the seven months they will search.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And everyone passing through the land and seeing a human bone will build beside it a marker until the buriers bury it in the Valley, Gog's Burial Place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And indeed the name of the city is Burial Place, and the land will be cleansed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord: Say to every bird and to all the beasts of the field, Gather and come; gather from all around to my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you, a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, and eat flesh and drink blood.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The flesh of giants you will eat and the blood of rulers of the earth you will drink, rams and calves and goats, all fattened calves.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will eat fat to fullness and drink blood to drunkenness from my sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will be filled at my table with horse and rider, a giant and every man of war, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will give my glory among you, and all the nations will see my judgment that I carried out and my hand that I brought upon them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the house of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God from this day and onward.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And all the nations will know that because of their sins the house of Israel was taken captive, because they rejected me and I turned my face away from them and handed them over into the hands of their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: According to their uncleannesses and according to their lawless deeds I dealt with them, and I turned my face away from them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will bear their own dishonor and the injustice by which they acted unjustly when they are settled on their land in peace and there is no one frightening them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When I turn them back from the nations and gather them from lands of the nations, I will be sanctified in them before the nations,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: then they will know that I am the Lord their God when I appear to them among the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will no longer turn my face away from them, because I poured out my wrath upon the house of Israel, says the Lord God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it happened in the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the first month, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was taken, on that day the hand of the Lord came upon me and led me,

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the man said to me, Have you seen, son of man? See with your eyes and hear with your ears and set in your heart all that I show you, because for the sake of showing you, you have entered here. And you will show the house of Israel all that you see.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he entered into the gate facing east, by seven steps, and measured the porch of the gate: one reed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the third chamber was one reed in width and one reed in length.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the porch of the gateway next to the porch of the gate was eight cubits, and the jambs two cubits, and the porch of the gate was inward.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he measured the width of the doorway of the gateway, ten cubits, and the breadth of the gateway, thirteen cubits.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.
