footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he measured the gate from the wall of one chamber to the wall of the other chamber, a breadth of twenty-five cubits, gate opposite gate.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the court of the porch of the gate was sixty cubits, with twenty chambers of the gate around.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And hidden windows were on the chambers and on the porches inside the gate of the court all around, and likewise the porches had windows all around inside, and on the porch were palms on this side and on that side.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the porticoes along the back of the gates, according to the length of the gates, the lower colonnade.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And behold, a gate facing north to the outer court, and he measured it, both its length and its breadth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And its chambers, three on this side and three on that side, and its jambs and its porches and its palms, and it was according to the measures of gate facing east: fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its breadth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And its windows and its porches and its palms were like the gate facing east, and by seven steps they went up to it, and its porches were inward.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And a gate was opposite a gate of the inner court toward south, and he measured the court from gate to gate, one hundred cubits in breadth toward south.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And he brought me into the inner court by the south gate and measured the gate according to these measures.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And its chambers and its jambs and its porches were according to these measures, and it and its porches had windows around: fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its breadth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And its porches were to the outer court, and palms were on the jambs, and there were eight steps.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore behold, I will lead her astray and appoint her to the wilderness and speak to her heart.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will give her her possessions from there and the valley of Achor to open her understanding, and she will be humbled there as in the days of her childhood and as in the days of her coming up from the land of Egypt.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be in that day, says the Lord, she will call me My-Husband and will no longer call me Baalim.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, and their names will no longer be remembered.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And in that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven and the reptiles of the earth, and I will shatter bow and sword and war from the land and make you dwell in hope.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will betroth you to myself forever, and I will betroth you to myself in righteousness and in judgment and in mercy and in compassions.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will betroth you to myself in faithfulness, and you will know the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be in that day, says the Lord, I will hear the heaven, and the heaven will hear the earth,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: and the earth will hear the grain and the wine and the oil, and these will hear Jezreel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will sow her for myself upon the land, and I will show mercy to Not-Shown-Mercy, and I will say to Not-My-People, You are my people, and he himself will say, You are the Lord my God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the Lord said to me, Go again, love a woman loving evil things and an adulteress, just as God loves the sons of Israel, and they look to foreign gods and love raisin cakes.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I hired her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer of barley and a jar of wine.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I said to her, Many days you will sit with me, and you will not prostitute yourself, nor will you become another man's; and I also will be toward you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And after these things the sons of Israel will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king and stand amazed at the Lord and at his good things in the last days.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Curse and lie and murder and theft and adultery have been poured out upon the land, and bloods mix with bloods.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore the land will mourn and be diminished with all inhabiting it, with the beasts of the field and with the reptiles of the earth and with the birds of heaven, and the fish of the sea will fail.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let no one judge and let no one rebuke, for my people are like a priest being contradicted.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And you will grow weak by day, and a prophet with you will also grow weak by night; I made your mother like you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: According to their multitude, so they sinned against me; I will turn their glory into dishonor.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They will eat the sins of my people, and in their injustices they will take their souls.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And it will be, as the people, so also the priest; and I will avenge on him for his ways and repay him his counsels.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will eat and will not be filled; they prostituted themselves and will not be made straight, because they abandoned the Lord so as not to keep him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Whoredom and wine and drunkenness took the heart of my people.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They were asking by symbols, and by his rods they were reporting to him. They were led astray by the spirit of whoredom and prostituted themselves away from their God.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: On the tops of mountains they were sacrificing, and on the hills they were sacrificing under an oak and a white poplar and a shady tree, because shelter is good. Therefore your daughters will prostitute themselves and your brides will commit adultery.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I will not visit your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your brides when they commit adultery, because they themselves mingled with prostitutes and were sacrificing with those initiated, and the people with understanding were entwined with a prostitute.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But you, Israel, do not be ignorant, and Judah, do not enter into Gilgal, and do not go up to the house of On, and do not swear, As the Lord lives.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because like a maddened heifer Israel was maddened; now the Lord will pasture them like a lamb in a broad place.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim, partner of idols, set stumbling blocks for himself.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He chose the Canaanites; in prostituting they prostituted themselves; they loved dishonor from their own boasting.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: You are a swirling wind in her wings, and they will be put to shame because of their altars.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Hear these things, priests, and pay attention, house of Israel, and the house of the king, listen closely, because the judgment is against you, because you became a snare at the lookout and like a net spread out on Tabor.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And those hunting the prey fixed it deep, but I am your disciplinarian.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not far from me, because now Ephraim prostituted itself and Israel was defiled.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the arrogance of Israel will be humbled before his face, and Israel and Ephraim will grow weak in their injustices, and Judah will grow weak with them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: With sheep and calves they will go to seek the Lord and will never find him, because he turned aside from them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because they abandoned the Lord, because foreign children were born to them; now mildew will devour them and their allotments.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Blow a trumpet on the hills, sound on the heights, proclaim in the house of On. Benjamin is amazed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim became for destruction in the days of rebuke; among the tribes of Israel I showed faithful things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The rulers of Judah became like those moving boundaries; on them I will pour out my rushing force like water.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim oppressed his adversary and trampled judgment, because he began to go after empty things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I am like turmoil to Ephraim and like a sting to the house of Judah.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his pain, and Ephraim went to Assyrians and sent envoys to King Jareb, but he was not able to heal you, nor will pain depart from you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because I am like a panther to Ephraim and like a lion to the house of Judah, and I will snatch and go away and take, and there will be no one delivering.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I will go and return to my place until they are destroyed and seek my face; in their affliction they will rise early toward me, saying,
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Let us go and return to the Lord our God, because he has snatched and he will heal us; he will strike and bind us up.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: He will heal us after two days; on the third day we will rise and live before him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And we will know; we will pursue knowing the Lord. We will find him ready as dawn, and he will come to us like early and latter rain to the earth.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What will I do to you, Ephraim? What will I do to you, Judah? Your mercy is like a morning cloud and like early dew going away.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because of this I cut down your prophets; I killed them by the words of my mouth, and my judgment will come out like light.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: But they are like a man transgressing a covenant; there he despised me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Gilead is a city working vanity, stirring water.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And your strength is that of a robber; priests hid the way of the Lord; they murdered at Shechem, because they worked lawlessness.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In the house of Israel I saw a horrible thing; there is whoredom of Ephraim; Israel and Judah were defiled.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Begin to gather grapes for yourself when I turn back captivity of my people.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: When I heal Israel, injustice of Ephraim and evil of Samaria will be uncovered, because they worked lies, and a thief will enter to him, a robber stripping on his road.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: So that they may sing together as those singing in their heart; I remembered all their evils. Now their counsels surrounded them; they came to be before my face.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: By their evils they gladdened kings, and by their lies rulers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They are all adulterers, like an oven burning for baking of a heated loaf, from the flame, from kneading the fat until it is leavened.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In the days of your kings the rulers began to be inflamed from wine; he stretched out his hand with pestilent ones.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because their hearts were kindled like an oven while they raged all night; Ephraim was filled with sleep. Morning came; it was kindled like a light of fire.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: All grew hot like an oven and devoured their judges; all their kings fell; there was none among them calling toward me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim mingled itself among his peoples; Ephraim became a cake not turned.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Foreigners devoured his strength, but he did not know, and gray hairs blossomed on him, and he did not know.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the arrogance of Israel will be humbled before his face, and they did not return to the Lord their God, and they did not seek him in all these things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Ephraim was like a foolish dove having no heart; he called on Egypt and they went to Assyrians.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As they go, I will cast my net on them; like birds of heaven I will bring them down; I will discipline them with the report of their affliction.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Woe to them, because they leaped away from me. They are cowardly because they acted impiously toward me. But I redeemed them, and they spoke lies against me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And their hearts did not cry to me, but they howled on their beds; for grain and wine they cut themselves; they were disciplined by me.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I strengthened their arms, but toward me they reckoned evil things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They turned aside to nothing; they became like a bent bow. Their rulers will fall by sword because of their undisciplined tongue. This is their scorn in the land of Egypt.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Into their bosom, like land, like an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they transgressed my covenant and acted impiously against my law.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They will cry to me, O God, we have known you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because Israel turned away from good things; they pursued an enemy.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They reigned for themselves, and not through me. They ruled, and they did not make it known to me. Their silver and their gold they made into idols for themselves, so that they might be destroyed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Cast off your calf, Samaria. My anger was provoked against them. How long will they be unable to be cleansed?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: For in Israel a craftsman made it, and it is not God, because your calf, Samaria, was leading astray.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because they sowed wind-blight, and their destruction will receive them. A handful has no strength to make flour; and if it does make it, foreigners will devour it.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Israel was swallowed up; now it became among the nations like a useless vessel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because they went up to Assyrians; Ephraim sprouted by itself; they loved gifts.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore they will be handed over among the nations. Now I will receive them, and they will cease a little from anointing a king and rulers.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because Ephraim multiplied altars; beloved altars became sins to him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I will write down for him a multitude, and his statutes were reckoned as foreign things, beloved altars.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because if they sacrifice a sacrifice and eat meats, the Lord will not accept them. Now he will remember their injustices and avenge their sins. They returned to Egypt, and among Assyrians they will eat unclean things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And Israel forgot the one who made him, and they built shrines, and Judah multiplied fortified cities. And I will send fire into his cities, and it will devour their foundations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Do not rejoice, Israel, nor be glad like the peoples, because you prostituted yourself away from your God. You loved gifts on every threshing floor of grain.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Threshing floor and winepress did not know them, and the wine deceived them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They did not dwell in the land of the Lord; Ephraim dwelt in Egypt, and among Assyrians they will eat unclean things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They did not pour out wine to the Lord, and their sacrifices did not please him. To them they are like bread of mourning; all eating them will be defiled, because their breads are for their souls; they will not enter into the house of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: What will you do in the day of assembly and in the day of the feast of the Lord?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Therefore behold, they will go from the misery of Egypt, and Memphis will receive them, and Michmash will bury them. Destruction will inherit their silver; thorns will be in their tents.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The days of vengeance have come; the days of your repayment have come, and Israel will be afflicted like the prophet out of his mind, a spirit-bearing man. Because of the multitude of your injustices, your madness was multiplied.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The watchman of Ephraim was with God; the prophet is a crooked snare on all his ways; they fixed madness deep in the house of the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They were corrupted according to the days of the hill; he will remember his injustice; he will avenge his sins.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Like a grape in the wilderness I found Israel, and like an early watchman in a fig tree I saw their fathers. They entered to Baal-peor and were estranged to shame, and beloved ones became like those abhorred.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim, like a bird, their glories flew away from births and birth-pangs and conceptions.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because even if they rear their children, they will become childless from men, because woe is also to them; my flesh is from them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim, as I saw, they presented their children for hunting, and Ephraim is to bring out his children for piercing.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Give to them, Lord. What will you give them? Give them a childless womb and dry breasts.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I will no longer love them
footnote_text: Greek literally says I will not add to love them. The body renders the idiom as I will no longer love them.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim suffered; his roots dried up; it will no longer bear fruit. Even if they bear children, I will kill the desires of their womb.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: God will reject them because they did not listen to him, and they will be wanderers among the nations.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Israel, a flourishing vine, her fruit prospered. According to the multitude of his fruits he multiplied the altars; according to the goodness of his land he built pillars.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: They divided their hearts; now they will be destroyed. He himself will dig down their altars; their pillars will suffer.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because now they will say, We have no king, because we did not fear the Lord. And the king, what will he do for us?
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Speaking words, false excuses, he will make a covenant; judgment will spring up like weed on the fallow ground of a field.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: The inhabitants of Samaria will dwell near the calf of the house of On, because his people mourned over it, and as they embittered him they will rejoice over his glory, because it was removed from him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And after binding it they carried it away to Assyrians as a guest-gift to King Jareb. Ephraim will receive it as a gift, and Israel will be ashamed in his counsel.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Samaria threw away her king like a twig on the face of water.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And altars of On, sins of Israel, will be removed; thorns and thistles will come up on their altars, and they will say to mountains, Cover us, and to hills, Fall on us.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: From time of the hills Israel sinned; there they stood. War against children of injustice will not overtake them on the hill.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: It came to discipline them, and peoples will be gathered against them when they are disciplined in their two injustices.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim is a heifer taught to love victory, but I will come upon the beauty of her neck. I will mount Ephraim and pass over Judah in silence; Jacob will prevail against him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Sow for yourselves into righteousness; reap into fruit of life. Light for yourselves light of knowledge. Seek the Lord until fruits of righteousness come to you.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Why did you pass over impiety in silence and reap its injustices? You ate false fruit, because you hoped in your chariots and in the multitude of your strength.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And destruction will rise up among your people, and all your fortified things will go away, as ruler Shalman from the house of Jerubbaal. In the days of war they leveled mother upon children.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Thus I will do to you, house of Israel, because of the face of your evils. At dawn they were thrown away; the king of Israel was thrown away.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Because Israel was an infant, and I loved him, and from Egypt I called his children.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: As I called them, so they went away from my face; they themselves were sacrificing to the Baals and burning incense to carved things.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And I bound Ephraim's feet together; I took him on my arm, and they did not know that I heal them.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: In ruin of men I stretched them out, in bonds of my love, and I will be to them like one striking a man on his jaws, and I will look toward him; I will prevail for him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim dwelt in Egypt, and Assyria itself is his king, because he was not willing to return.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And the sword grew weak in his cities and ceased in his hands, and they will eat from their counsels.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And his people were hanging suspended from his dwelling, and God will be angered over his precious things and will never exalt him.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: How shall I deal with you, Ephraim? Shall I shield you, Israel? How shall I deal with you? I will make you like Admah and set you like Zeboiim. My heart was turned within me; my repentance was stirred together.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I will not act according to the anger of my wrath; I will not abandon Ephraim to be wiped out, because I am God and not man, a holy one in you, and I will not enter into a city.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: I will go after the Lord; like a lion he will roar, because he himself will roar, and children of the waters will stand amazed.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: And they will stand amazed like a bird out of Egypt and like a dove from the land of the Assyrians, and I will restore them to their houses, says the Lord.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.

trigger_phrase: Ephraim surrounded me with falsehood, and the house of Israel and Judah with impieties; but now God knows them, and they will be called God's holy people.
footnote_text: Brenton differs here. The translation follows the current fresh wording at this verse numbering point.
